_note: Necessary conditions for an HLD (design documents). Code checks each one on hld.md after every build; the HLD is workable only when all are met and Audit accepts. "check" names the code check in j2.condition_met(). "plan" (optional): words a workflow in Adaptation's plan must mention, or the plan is flagged before building.

conditions.text: All six sections are present and not empty
Components have unique sequential ids (C1, C2, ...) and each states its responsibility
Every PRD requirement appears in an HLD component
conditions.label: PRD requirements

conditions.text: No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter, the Requester's answers or the PRD, or sits in an Assumption: line
Nothing is "to be confirmed", and every brief fact appears exactly
